subject: RM_Fuzzrunner
departures: near-spherical body swollen round with stored fog-fat, with almost no neck or waist, so it reads as a ball rather than an elongated rodent
whole body under a dense, even fuzz coat, so the head, body and limbs merge into one soft round mass
oversized whisker array as the dominant facial feature, larger than the eyes, which are small or reduced (the animal never stands in open light)
pebble-like silhouette that could pass for a stone when it is still: smooth rounded outline with nothing poking out
broad, rounded shoulders worn smooth from pushing along narrow stem runs
